name: Test Contract Baseline Guard
description: When any JS, JSX, HTML, or CSS file is saved, remind the developer to run the contract test suite and verify no regressions.

actions.prompt:
The file {{filePath}} was just saved. This project has 130+ test suites and 1,587+ tests that guard DOM contracts, class names, IDs, import order, and bridge encoding. Remind the developer:

1. Run `npm test` to verify no contract regressions
2. The test baseline allows exactly 5 failed suites and 9 failed tests (pre-existing)
3. The class-contract baseline (tests/fixtures/class-contract.baseline.json) pins 106 interactive IDs, 104 static IDs, 31 classes, and 8 data attributes
4. The CSS import order in style.css (11 modules) must not change
5. Total test count must remain ≥ 1,587

If the saved file is a test file (tests/**), also check that no .skip, .only, xit, xtest, or xdescribe was added to existing tests.
